context.problem_statement: Given the eCommerce dataset with sales transactions, your task is to perform a seasonal decomposition of the monthly revenue time series. Specifically, you need to calculate and report the total revenue for each month. This will help identify any seasonal patterns in the revenue generated by the eCommerce platform.
context.expert_knowledge: Seasonal decomposition is used to identify and separate seasonal patterns in time series data. In an eCommerce context, this helps in understanding how monthly revenue fluctuates due to seasonal trends, which can be critical for inventory management, marketing strategies, and financial forecasting.
